(1) we can transfer similarity across tasks and domains, (2) we can learn a similarity network from source data, and (3) the similarity network can be used to learn a clustering network that can perform unsupervised domain transfer and cross-task transfer.

1) we can perform unsupervised domain and task adaptation using only pairwise semantic similarity; 2) we can learn a clustering network using a constrained clustering loss; 3) the similarity network is a robust feature extractor; 4) we can reconstruct semantic categories with high accuracy; and 5) we achieve state of the art performance in cross-domain and cross-task adaptation
